advisory.finding: The inverse-aware cross-ticket dedup only suppresses a mirror when the counterpart already carries the inverse edge in its local deps. For a genuinely-new blocking link visible from both Jira endpoints where NEITHER local ticket yet carries the dep, processing both endpoints in the same pass emits both directions (blocks X->Y and depends_on Y->X), creating a duplicate/mirror edge on first adoption — the very outcome the change claims to prevent ('rebar stores each blocking edge ONCE').
scenarios: A new Blocks link created directly in Jira between two active, already-bound local tickets that have no local dep yet: first reconcile pass emits both 'blocks' and 'depends_on', writing a redundant reverse edge.
